note: Routers a PR chose NOT to mount, each with a one-line reason. Created 2026-07-21 by CofC ruling as the escape hatch that makes --enforce satisfiable: the builder is structurally incapable of mounting (module_from_exemplar lane guard + edit-class output_file:null no-ops 4 of 6 gates), so without this the ratchet would be an unsatisfiable predicate and ~15 builder PRs/day would go red for a rule none could comply with. Declaring is not mounting -- a deferred module still counts in orphan_count and the census stays truthful; the declaration only buys headroom against the ratchet. RULES: (1) every entry needs a non-empty reason, (2) remove the entry the moment the module is mounted or deleted -- a stale deferral fails the gate because it silently inflates headroom, (3) >40 active deferrals is a documented REOPEN TRIGGER for the council, not a number to raise. Format: {"module_stem": "reason"} or {"module_stem": {"reason": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}}.
